description: A life-threatening disease caused by parasites that are transmitted to people through the bites of infected female Anopheles mosquitoes.
prevention: Prevent mosquito bites and take antimalarial medications.
treatment_action: Prescription drugs to kill the parasite.
complications: Cerebral malaria, breathing problems, and organ failure.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A highly contagious viral infection that is serious for small children but is easily preventable by a vaccine.
symptoms: Tiny white spots inside the mouth
treatment_action: Rest, fluids, and fever reducers. No specific antiviral treatment.

description: An inflammation of the fluid and membranes (meninges) surrounding your brain and spinal cord.
treatment_action: Antibiotics (for bacterial) or supportive care (for viral).
complications: Hearing loss, memory difficulty, and brain damage.

description: A potentially disabling disease of the brain and spinal cord (central nervous system).
causes: Autoimmune reaction where the immune system attacks the protective sheath (myelin) that covers nerve fibers.
complications: Muscle stiffness or spasms, paralysis, and mental changes.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A viral infection that primarily affects the parotid glands — one of three pairs of saliva-producing (salivary) glands.
complications: Inflammation of the testicles (orchitis), brain (encephalitis), and ovaries.

description: A chronic autoimmune neuromuscular disease that causes weakness in the skeletal muscles.
causes: Breakdown in the normal communication between nerves and muscles.
symptoms: Drooping of one or both eyelids
treatment_action: Medications (cholinesterase inhibitors, corticosteroids) and sometimes surgery.
